#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

long long modPow(long long base, long long exp) {
    const long long MOD = 1000000007;
    long long result = 1;
    for (long long i = 0; i < exp; i++) {
        result = (result * base) % MOD;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    long long p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    
    long long exponent;
    if (k == 0) {
        exponent = p - 1;
    } else if (k == 1) {
        exponent = p;
    } else {
        long long current = k;
        long long steps = 1;
        while (current != 1) {
            current = (current * k) % p;
            steps++;
        }
        exponent = (p - 1) / steps;
    }
    
    cout << modPow(p, exponent) << endl;
    return 0;
}
